name: Flywheel / Flexplate Interface
description: Rear crank flange fasteners, pilot bearing and bellhousing alignment (clutch/flywheel in drivetrain).

components.name: Crank rear flange & flywheel/flexplate bolts
components.description: The 8-bolt rear crank flange where the flywheel (manual) or flexplate (auto) bolts on. The flywheel and clutch belong to drivetrain; this item covers the flange and its fasteners.
components.location: Rear of the crankshaft at the bellhousing face (x about 0.38-0.40 m).

factory.name: GM 8-bolt crank flange; GM ZL1 flywheel bolts (set of 8)

raceOptions.name: ARP flywheel bolts for Gen V 8-bolt flange
raceOptions.notes: Use ARP torque with Ultra-Torque; part number not verified here.

hardware.torque: 11 ft-lb (15 N·m), then 22 ft-lb (30 N·m), then +45°
hardware.threadlocker: Per GM (bolts may have pre-applied threadlocker)

hardware.torque: 133 in-lb (15 N·m), then 22 ft-lb (30 N·m), then +45°

installNotes: Clean flange and bolt holes; check flywheel dowel; star-pattern torque.

sources.title: Summit Racing Help Center: Chevrolet LT Gen. 5 LT1/LT2 Torque Specs
Michigan Motorsports: LS / LT Engine Torque Specs (2014+ Gen V LT section)
Wild Hammer: 17-24 Camaro ZL1 flywheel bolts (set of 8), GM

modelRef.dimensions: 8-bolt flange ~100 mm dia, bolt circle ~76 mm, M11 bolts
modelRef.features: Machined flange with 8 bolt holes, one locating dowel and the pilot bore

components.name: Pilot bearing
components.description: Bearing pressed into the crank flange bore that supports the transmission input shaft nose (manual trans).
components.location: Center of the rear crank flange.

factory.name: GM pilot bearing
factory.notes: Verify size for your trans input shaft.

installNotes: Press in square with a driver until flush/at specified depth; do not grease sealed bearings.
inspection: Check for roughness at every clutch change.

sources.title: Summit Racing Help Center: Chevrolet LT Gen. 5 LT1/LT2 Torque Specs

images.title: GM 12732518 Gen V forged crankshaft (SD Parts photo)

modelRef.features: Sealed roller/ball pilot bearing pressed into the crank flange bore

components.name: Block-to-bellhousing dowels & bellhousing bolts
components.description: Hollow dowels in the block rear face align the bellhousing to the crank centerline; misalignment wears the pilot bearing and input shaft.
installNotes: Dial-indicate bellhousing runout if using an aftermarket bellhousing.

sources.title: Summit Racing Help Center: Chevrolet LT Gen. 5 LT1/LT2 Torque Specs
